### Automated WCAG 2.1 / 2.2 accessibility testing · *Founder* · [adaguard.io](https://www.adaguard.io)

A live SaaS that scans websites for WCAG problems, shows each issue with its element, a screenshot and the code to fix it, and tracks the score as teams fix them.

**Tech stack**

![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-3776AB?style=flat-square&logo=python&logoColor=white) ![FastAPI](https://img.shields.io/badge/FastAPI-009688?style=flat-square&logo=fastapi&logoColor=white) ![Next.js 16](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js_16-000000?style=flat-square&logo=nextdotjs&logoColor=white) ![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-20232A?style=flat-square&logo=react&logoColor=61DAFB) ![Vite](https://img.shields.io/badge/Vite-646CFF?style=flat-square&logo=vite&logoColor=white) ![Socket.IO](https://img.shields.io/badge/Socket.IO-010101?style=flat-square&logo=socketdotio&logoColor=white) ![MongoDB Atlas](https://img.shields.io/badge/MongoDB_Atlas-47A248?style=flat-square&logo=mongodb&logoColor=white) ![Redis](https://img.shields.io/badge/Redis-DC382D?style=flat-square&logo=redis&logoColor=white) ![Playwright](https://img.shields.io/badge/Playwright-2EAD33?style=flat-square&logo=playwright&logoColor=white) ![axe--core](https://img.shields.io/badge/axe--core-663399?style=flat-square&logo=deque&logoColor=white) ![Cloudflare R2](https://img.shields.io/badge/Cloudflare_R2-F38020?style=flat-square&logo=cloudflare&logoColor=white) ![Vercel](https://img.shields.io/badge/Vercel-000000?style=flat-square&logo=vercel&logoColor=white) ![Railway](https://img.shields.io/badge/Railway-0B0D0E?style=flat-square&logo=railway&logoColor=white) ![Docker](https://img.shields.io/badge/Docker-2496ED?style=flat-square&logo=docker&logoColor=white) ![Resend](https://img.shields.io/badge/Resend-000000?style=flat-square&logo=resend&logoColor=white)

```
Browser → Next.js 16 (Vercel)  →  FastAPI API (Railway)  ←→  Scan workers (Redis queue)
                                         ↓                          ↓
                    MongoDB Atlas · Redis cache · Cloudflare R2   Playwright Chromium + axe-core
```

**What I built**

- **Scanner engine:** Playwright headless Chromium running axe-core plus **22 custom checkers**, judged against the **accessibility tree** and confirmed on rendered pixels; validated against the **W3C ACT Rules** suite
- **Scale & safety:** Redis-queued **scan workers** separate from the API, up to **1,000 pages per site** (sitemap or crawl), and an egress proxy that blocks private/internal addresses (SSRF-safe)
- **Standards:** scores against WCAG 2.0 / 2.1 / 2.2 (A–AAA), ADA, Section 508, EN 301 549 and more; history re-scores without a rescan
- **Scans behind a login:** encrypted remote-browser sessions (SSO, 2FA and magic links work; passwords never seen)
- **Platform:** public versioned **REST API** (`/v1`), real-time progress over Socket.IO, PDF / VPAT reports, subscription billing and usage metering, a React admin panel, and an **MCP server** so Claude can run admin tasks

**On GitHub**

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [![GitHub App](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub_App-ADAGuard_Accessibility-181717?style=flat-square&logo=github)](https://github.com/apps/adaguard-accessibility) | Scans every pull request's preview deployment (Vercel, Netlify, GitHub Pages…), posts the result as a **PR comment and check run**, and can **block merges** on critical issues. Configured per repo with `.adaguard.yml`. |
| [![GitHub Marketplace](https://img.shields.io/badge/Marketplace-ADAGuard_Accessibility_Scan-2088FF?style=flat-square&logo=githubactions&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/marketplace/actions/adaguard-accessibility-scan) | **GitHub Action** that scans a URL from CI and **fails the build** when the score drops below `min-score`. |

```yaml
- uses: adaguard-io/accessibility-action@v1
  with:
    api-key: ${{ secrets.ADAGUARD_API_KEY }}
    url: https://staging.example.com
    min-score: 80
```
